title: Downgrade inflated concept scores after creator rejection
starting_state: A concept-selection artifact gives 28-29/30 scores and PASS_NO_CAP to a route the creator rejected as unsendable.
The workflow still treats the route as calibrated evidence for future jams.
done_when: Creator rejection overrides inflated score artifacts.
Rejected lanes are marked STOP / do not polish / do not re-present unless explicitly reopened.
Taste gate caps prevent common relatable tropes from scoring above the threshold without novelty and creator-world specificity.
forbidden_changes: Do not hide creator rejection evidence.
Do not lower the 28/30 bar globally.
Do not keep rejected routes as positive calibration examples.
fail_to_pass: creator-rejected routes with inflated scores become STOP/rebuild evidence and cannot remain 28+ calibrated winners
pass_to_pass: valid high-scoring concepts can still pass when novelty, creator-world specificity, staged proof, and sendability evidence are present
anti_gaming_notes: Hidden checker should seed a different rejected concept with high scores and require the rejection note to cap or invalidate the score.
